python.name: AI Engine Validation (Python)
python.dockerCommand: sh -c "pip install -r ai-engine/requirements.txt pytest pytest-json-report httpx && AI_ENGINE_URL=http://ai-service:8000 pytest RootScripts/scripts.test/test/ai-engine.tests --json-report --json-report-file=/tmp/results.json"

load.name: Load & Stress Testing (Node.js)
load.dockerCommand: sh -c "cd RootScripts/scripts.test/test/load-test && npm install && API_URL=http://backend node resilience-stress.js /tmp/results.json"

load-breaking-point.name: Breaking Point Stress Test
load-breaking-point.dockerCommand: sh -c "cd RootScripts/scripts.test/test/load-test && npm install axios && API_URL=http://backend node breaking-point-stress.js"

load-massive-batch.name: Massive Batch Dispatch Test
load-massive-batch.dockerCommand: sh -c "cd RootScripts/scripts.test/test/load-test && npm install axios && API_URL=http://backend node massive-batch-dispatch.js"

load-chaos-reconnect.name: Chaos Reconnect Resilience Test
load-chaos-reconnect.dockerCommand: sh -c "cd RootScripts/scripts.test/test/load-test && npm install axios @microsoft/signalr && API_URL=http://backend node chaos-reconnect.js"

simulator.name: E2E Simulators (Node.js)
simulator.dockerCommand: sh -c "cd RootScripts/scripts.test/test/e2e-simulator && npm install && export DELIVERY_API_URL=http://backend/api/v1 DELIVERY_HUB_URL=http://backend/hubs/tracking DELIVERY_HEALTH_URL=http://backend/health DELIVERY_OSRM_URL=http://osrm:5000 && node simulate-e2e.js /tmp/r1.json && node test-flutter-compat.js /tmp/r2.json && node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const a=fs.existsSync('/tmp/r1.json')?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/r1.json')).testCases:[]; const b=fs.existsSync('/tmp/r2.json')?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/r2.json')).testCases:[]; fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/results.json', JSON.stringify({testCases: [...a, ...b]}));\""
